title: dock on second display wont display icons
summary: The issue reports that PC Vitals icons appear on the primary monitor but not a second monitor, but it is filed against Command Palette with minimal reproduction detail and an outdated PowerToys version. The automated triage comment specifically requests updated-version confirmation and concrete reproduction steps.

status.label: needs information
status.detail: Request confirmation on the latest stable release and a complete multi-monitor reproduction including display arrangement, scaling, and dock settings.

judgment.rationale: The issue reports that PC Vitals icons appear on the primary monitor but not a second monitor, but it is filed against Command Palette with minimal reproduction detail and an outdated PowerToys version. The automated triage comment specifically requests updated-version confirmation and concrete reproduction steps.
evidence: Reported version is 0.11.11762.0 from the Microsoft Store.
The body provides one screenshot but no monitor topology, display arrangement, scaling, dock configuration, or exact steps beyond the observed symptom.
The issue has Needs-Author-Feedback and Needs-Triage labels and no assignee.
The latest public comment requests reproduction details and confirmation against stable release 0.100.2.
judgment.recommended_action: Request confirmation on the latest stable release and a complete multi-monitor reproduction including display arrangement, scaling, and dock settings.

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this. Please update PowerToys to the latest stable release and confirm whether the issue still occurs. If it does, please provide:

- The exact PowerToys version and installation source.
- The number of monitors, their arrangement, resolution, scaling percentage, and which monitor is primary.
- Whether the PC Vitals dock is enabled and which dock settings are selected.
- The exact steps used to open or display the dock on the secondary monitor.
- Whether other Command Palette dock content appears on the secondary monitor, or only PC Vitals is missing.
- A fresh PowerToys bug report ZIP captured while the problem is present.
